Sam (Design): quick design review — focus on keyboard-first flows and microcopy for performance badges in the model catalog compare. noticing a few accessibility and discoverability nits.
Yara (Eng): sounds good. what are the main pain points?
Sam (Design): 1) badges have small click targets and no clear keyboard focus; 2) badge labels are inconsistent (e.g., "latency: good" vs "latency ok"); 3) pin action is visually similar to badge icons and causes misclicks.
Devin (Product): users reported accidentally pinning when trying to inspect badges in tests. copy inconsistency also made quick scans harder.
Ava (A11y): for keyboard: badges must be reachable via Tab with a visible focus ring. Use tabindex=0 on badge wrappers and aria-labels with full phrasing (e.g., "Latency: good — 42ms"). For the pin, use aria-pressed and a unique label ("Enter pin mode" or "Pin this version").
Noah (Research): in 8 usability sessions, 3 users tried arrow navigation inside the compare grid expecting left/right to move between badges. they were surprised when arrow keys scrolled the page.
Yara (Eng): we can add roving tabindex for badge groups so arrow keys cycle badges inside a row. that's a small widget and well-scoped.
Sam (Design): microcopy proposal: canonical badge labels should be short but consistent: "latency — ok/fair/slow", "cost — low/med/high", "throughput — good/poor". keep tooltips for numeric detail.
Devin (Product): agreed. also propose a compact legend accessible from header: "Legend (L)" that opens an inline panel with full phrases so new users can learn the shorthand.
Ava (A11y): ensure legend is a dialog with role=dialog, focus trap, and an accessible close. When labels change, announce the change with aria-live polite if the legend is open.
Yara (Eng): implementation notes: add .badge:focus styles, data-role="badge-group" for roving tabindex, and aria-labels for each badge. Pin icon gets data-role="pin-action" and distinct keyboard shortcut (p to toggle pin mode when header in focus).
Noah (Research): let's test the shortcut with power users; some may find global shortcuts surprising. add a small hint in the header tooltip: "Press P to enter pin mode".
Sam (Design): also visual: increase contrast for the OK/GOOD green to meet AA at 12px. Ava suggested #2b9b45 in prev thread — works for me.
Ava (A11y): confirmed that #2b9b45 passes AA at small sizes against white. if we keep lighter token for larger chips that's fine, but ensure text always meets contrast.
Devin (Product): telemetry: add events badge_focused, badge_shortcut_used, pin_mode_toggled, legend_opened. also track misclicks on pin vs badge for 2 weeks post-launch.
Yara (Eng): estimate: 3 dev days for roving tabindex + focus styles + a11y labels; 1 day to wire telemetry; small CSS token tweak.
infra-bot: preview build queued — review app will be at https://staging.redwood.company/review/6789 in ~20m.
Sam (Design): I'll upload a tiny spec: canonical labels, focus states, legend copy, and tooltip timing (250ms hover, immediate on focus). will also include Figma snippets.
Ava (A11y): I'll run axe on the preview and validate keyboard flow.
Devin (Product): thanks team. main action items: finalize canonical badge copy, implement keyboard roving for badges, separate pin affordance visually and semantically, and add legend + telemetry. Ping product if anything blocks. :sparkles:
